strings.download.linux.lede: Same steps — the mod is platform-neutral; only the paths differ. Works natively or via Proton.
strings.download.linux.loader_issue: If the game won't load mods on your distro, that's a BaseLib (loader) issue, not the cards — tell me and we'll sort it.
strings.download.linux.step_1: Find mods/: right-click Slay the Spire 2 → Manage → Browse local files (works for native & Proton). Usually ~/.steam/steam/steamapps/common/Slay the Spire 2/ or ~/.local/share/Steam/steamapps/common/Slay the Spire 2/. Make a mods folder if needed.
strings.download.linux.step_2: Unzip into it: unzip BlankTheSpire-{version}.zip -d "<game dir>/mods" → you get mods/BaseLib/ and mods/BlankTheSpire/.
strings.download.linux.step_3: Launch. The log lives under your user data, not %APPDATA% — fastest way to find it: find ~ -name godot.log 2>/dev/null. (Native: ~/.local/share/Godot/app_userdata/SlayTheSpire2/logs/; Proton: inside steamapps/compatdata/2868840/pfx/…/AppData/Roaming/SlayTheSpire2/logs/.)
strings.download.linux.title: On Linux (Ubuntu / Steam, incl. Steam Deck)

strings.help.intro.body: Inside the game, not on this site. Forge a class here, copy its import code (it starts with BTSC.), then in Slay the Spire 2 open the main menu → Mod Configuration → BlankTheSpire → paste it into the Class code field under Import a class code and press Import. strings.help.next.title: Next
strings.help.steps.step_1: Forge a class on the site and press Copy code. The code starts with BTSC. and ends with a short hash — copy all of it.
strings.help.steps.step_1_alt: The forge result on blankthespire.com with the Copy code button
strings.help.steps.step_1_caption: The result view on the site — the import code box and its Copy code button.
strings.help.steps.step_2: Launch Slay the Spire 2 and open the main menu → Mod Configuration. (the mod must be subscribed on Steam Workshop first — once)
strings.help.steps.step_2_alt: The Slay the Spire 2 main menu with the Mod Configuration entry highlighted
strings.help.steps.step_2_caption: Main menu — the Mod Configuration entry.
strings.help.steps.step_3: Choose BlankTheSpire from the list of installed mods on the left.
strings.help.steps.step_3_alt: The mod list with BlankTheSpire selected and its settings open
strings.help.steps.step_3_caption: The mod list — pick BlankTheSpire to open its settings.
strings.help.steps.step_4: Paste the code into the "Class code" field and press Import. (the field sits under Import a class code; leave "Class slot" at 0 and the mod picks a free slot for you)
strings.help.steps.step_4_alt: The Class code field with a BTSC code pasted in and the Import button ready
strings.help.steps.step_4_caption: The Class code field with the code pasted and Import ready to press.
strings.help.steps.step_5: Restart the game — press Restart game (applies changes) on the same screen.
strings.help.steps.step_5_alt: The mod's restart-required confirmation after a successful import
strings.help.steps.step_5_callout: The restart is REQUIRED. The mod will say so right after the import. A newly imported class is only loaded at startup — it will not appear at character select until you fully quit and relaunch the game.
strings.help.steps.step_5_caption: The confirmation after a successful import — restart before you look for the class.
strings.help.steps.step_6: Start a new run and pick your class from the character select screen.
strings.help.steps.step_6_alt: The character select screen showing a forged class
strings.help.steps.step_6_caption: Character select — your forged class sits alongside the base-game characters.
strings.help.steps.title: Step by step
strings.help.trouble.no_class: The class doesn't appear at character select. You didn't restart. Quit the game completely and relaunch — imported classes only load at startup.
strings.help.trouble.no_mods: There's no Mod Configuration entry / the game isn't modded. The mod isn't installed yet — see Get the mod.
strings.help.trouble.other: Anything else. Report a bug on GitHub. If the game crashed, include the lines from %APPDATA%\SlayTheSpire2\logs\godot.log.
strings.help.trouble.rejected: "Code rejected" / "invalid code". Make sure the whole code was copied — including the BTSC. prefix at the front and the short hash after the final dot. A code cut off at either end can't be decoded. The Copy code button always copies the whole thing.

strings.workshop.description:
[h1]Custom playable classes for Slay the Spire 2![/h1]

Describe a class in plain English at [url=https://blankthespire.com]blankthespire.com[/url] — [i]"a venomous plague doctor who sacrifices health to stack poison, then turns blood into armor"[/i] — and the forge turns it into a real, playable Slay the Spire 2 character with its own cards, relic, mechanics, potion and identity. You get an import code; paste it in-game and play.

[b]Unofficial fan mod. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Mega Crit.[/b]

[h2]How to play[/h2]
[olist]
[*]Subscribe to this mod (BaseLib is a dependency and installs automatically).
[*]Go to [url=https://blankthespire.com]blankthespire.com[/url] and forge a class — you'll get an import code starting with [b]BTSC.[/b] (No time to forge? The site lists ready-made starter classes to copy.)
[*]In-game: main menu → Mod Configuration → BlankTheSpire → paste the code into [b]Import a class code[/b] → Import → Restart game.
[*]Start a new run and pick your forged class.
[/olist]

Forging happens on the website, not in this mod. Bring your own LLM API key and forge as much as you like, or use the site's hosted models. This Workshop item is free and open source, and contains no purchases. You are free to visit the site and play other user's classes.

[h2]Transparency: AI-generated content[/h2]
Forged classes (card text, names, splash art) are generated by AI on the website, at your request, and enter the game only through your import code. This Workshop package itself contains no AI-generated assets — it is the mod's human-written runtime plus the vocabulary of mechanics the generator is allowed to use. Generation is constrained to that vocabulary and schema-validated, so forged classes are guaranteed to load and play.

[h2]Known issues (early build)[/h2]
[list]
[*]Placeholder art in places — orbs are plain colored circles; some card art is generic.
[*]The in-game Relics compendium can throw a harmless mod-loader error; back out and keep playing.
[*]You must restart after importing a class — the mod tells you; it's normal.
[*]Balance is loose by design — expect the occasional swingy or hilariously broken card. Tell us what breaks.
[/list]

[h2]Feedback and source[/h2]
Bugs, hangs, or broken cards: [url=https://github.com/ryanrinkel/BLANKthespire/issues]open a GitHub issue[/url]. The mod is open source (MIT) at [url=https://github.com/ryanrinkel/BLANKthespire]github.com/ryanrinkel/BLANKthespire[/url]. It includes no game code, binaries, or copyrighted game data — you need to own Slay the Spire 2.
